text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I head out to observe a
winning concert.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ngh... There simply must be a way to overcome this dilemma in a more excellent fashion!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, yes. I'm gathering reference
and
preparing for my inevitable winning
concert!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To all Umamusume, the winning concert
is a place
where they can truly shine.
However! There is but
one major issue!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And that is... the matter of time!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I only get to perform but a single song!
How can I
possibly show the audience
the full extent of my
charm in so little
time?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if only they would allow us to
increase the
tempo of the pieces!
Perhaps then I could
squeeze in a few
more!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Perform with everything I've got? Ah!
That's it!
choice_data_list: 限られた時間に全力をぶつける方が……
枠に縛られない考えは大事だね

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Rather than risk overstaying my welcome
and
becoming a bore, I should use my
time to leave
an impact! Is my
interpretation correct?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! What an exemplary
suggestion!
That's quite astute of you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is only a single song, I'm
certain I can
put on the most memorable
performance for the
audience!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Time to create a dazzling performance
that only
I, T.M. Opera O, am capable
of!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Yes, that is exactly what I
shall do!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Some day, I shall claim the title of
Centurial
Overlord and illuminate the
world with my
presence!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As the sun shines unfettered in the sky,
so, too,
must I reign free of any
restraints!
